definitions.short: Pul , the name of an Assyrian king and of an Ethiopian tribe
definitions.full: H6322. Pul מּוּל proper name, masculine = מְּלֶאסֶר תִּגְלַת (q. v.) (Assyrian Pulu ; Babylonian name of Tiglath-pileser, Schr SBAk 1887, 592; KB ii, 287, compare 277 Tiele Gesch 266 f. ; compare (through Persian tradition, EMey Entstehung, 30 ) Πῶρος , Canon of Ptolemy KAT 2, 490 ); 2Kin 15:19 (twice in verse); 1Chr 5:26 , Φουα[λ] . — Isa 66:19 , see פוט .
